ms.report:
Here is our POV for Milestone 3:
 ✅ Fully functional and already deployed prototype:
・Published codebase on GitHub repository with complete source code: https://github.com/TrustLevel/Grant_Review_Tool
・Deployed backend service with REST API and MongoDB integration
・Deployed frontend built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS

 ✅ Complete tool documentation:
・./docs/deployment/installation.md with detailed setup manual
・./docs/developer-guide/api-reference.md covering all system endpoints
・./docs/developer-guide/algorithms.md detailing model logic
・./docs/admin-guide/user-management.md for system operations

 ✅ Testing reports:
・ ./tests/README.md with 5 categories and 15+ test scripts
・ Test coverage for core functionality, authentication, workflows, and database operations
・ Testing methodologies documented with execution procedures

Full Video Tour:
